name: Rubin Naiman
abstract_title:
From Cognitive Behavior Therapy to Consciousness Behavior Therapy

     -- Exploring the Clinical Potentials of Consciousness Studies
abstract: Cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) has been extensively investigated and deemed effective for a range of psychiatric disorders. Today, CBT is the most common form of psychotherapy practiced in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and other parts of the globe. Despite its popularity, there is growing controversy about its empirical support, evidence of its declining effectiveness, and ongoing concerns about its limited scope and mechanistic style.
